dedupe_keys.name: ai based exergy analysis of a multi section cement plant using high ash indian coal a case study

description: Abhijeet Bajpai publishes a generic dry-process cement-plant flowsheet, sample data and Python analysis code parameterised for high-ash Indian coal. Six process sections cover milling through clinker cooling. The Zenodo record supplies an Aspen backup, CSV data and scripts; a linked GitHub repository and archived release provide additional workflow code. Download is free, with CC BY 4.0 stated for data and MIT for code in the README. Full process calculations require licensed Aspen Plus V14 on Windows. The materials can support exergy and operating-point simulations. Related catalogue record platform-aspen-plus-process-simulation covers the solver. The README claims that superseded scripts are absent, but several are actually listed in the Zenodo inventory; GitHub exposes newer preflight and hybrid-model scripts. Package consistency and numerical correctness remain unverified. No code, flowsheet or reported optimum was executed.
